By way of this application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973,
the applicant seeks bail in the event of his arrest in connection with FIR No. 0407/2022, dated 12.04.2022, registered at Police Station Sultanpuri, under Sections 498A/306/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The applicant was married to the deceased on 29.01.2005.
On 17.05.2016, the applicant's wife died and the brother of the deceased registered a complaint at the police station, contending that the deceased was harassed by the applicant and his family.
Although the complaint was made on 17.05.2016, the FIR was registered more than six years thereafter, on 12.04.2022.
Learned APP for the State, on instructions, submits that as per the order dated 05.05.2022, the applicant has joined and cooperated with the investigation.

It is further submitted that the investigation in the present case is complete and chargesheet has been filed before the court of competent jurisdiction and that the present applicant is not required for any custodial interrogation.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court deems fit to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant.

In the event of his arrest, the applicant is directed to be released forthwith, upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 25,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/learned trial Court, with the following conditions:-
i. The applicant shall not leave the country without prior permission of the learned trial Court.
ii. The applicant shall intimate the learned trial Court by way of an affidavit and to the Investigating Officer regarding any change in residential address.
